key_catalyst: Brent crude surges above $100 as Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers widen the Iran-aligned conflict
reasoning: Brent crude breaching $100 after expanded Houthi attacks is a novel escalation of an already damaging geopolitical and inflationary theme, while Treasury yields reached multi-month highs. The market has not fully absorbed the risk: QQQ fell 1.90% on July 23 and another 1.37% today as oil worsened and Alphabet/Tesla exposed broader AI-capex cash-burn concerns, creating material overnight gap-down risk.
